purpose: Reviewed input to later combined-checkout assembly and extraction; this file does not perform either operation.

artifactPlacement.rule: Consolidation inputs live at the combined repository root, outside apps/ui. Later assembly must preserve these root inputs and validate both schema versions and review digests before consuming them.

captureBinding.lookup: Resolve each sourceInputRef.serviceId to exactly one complete captured source and use its capture identity and digest; do not resolve a floating branch or recapture source inside assembly.
captureBinding.schemaHandoff: The capture task owns the manifest schema and capture identities. Its eventual schema must support these service-qualified references; adapt a reader if field spelling differs, without rewriting captured facts.
assemblyPrerequisites: All five references resolve to complete, verified captures.
Boundary and generation design digests are reviewed.
History and visibility review supplies its own approved recipe.

workspace.rationale: All three TypeScript applications already use pnpm. Workspaces preserve separate package manifests and build tools while replacing sibling-checkout links with declared dependencies in one lockfile.
workspace.dependencyPolicy: Runtime and build dependencies stay in their owning manifests. Root dependencies are repository tooling only. Preserve consumer-specific React, TypeScript and generator versions; do not flatten incompatible versions through global overrides.
workspace.installPolicy: Carry reviewed minimumReleaseAge, native/build-script allowlists and the existing Playwright release-age exception into one root pnpm-workspace.yaml. Replace link: overrides with workspace dependencies. Keep browser React/React DOM peers aligned without forcing the CLI Ink dependency graph onto the browser version.
workspace.buildRunner: pnpm filtered scripts; no additional task-runner adoption in this design

extraction.inspectionLimits: Counts include tests and scripts and describe this inspection, not an immutable captured source. Static imports/exports were traversed, including type edges; runtime bundling has not been verified here.
evidence: UI Common clients/index.ts exports WebClientProvider and runtime.ts imports browser configuration.
The full agents barrel reaches finalAssessmentTaskNeighborhood, workItemSections and entityIcons; extracting that entire barrel would pull UI dependencies across the boundary.
Capability catalog imports generated API enums but has no React dependency.
CLI currently builds all UI Common dist plus CLI declarations before bundling; the extracted boundary removes that requirement.

importPolicy.enforcement: Later assembly adds a root check:boundaries command and CI gate. Resolve static imports, re-exports, literal dynamic imports and require calls to owning packages, validate declared dependencies and explicit exports, forbid cross-package relative paths and transitive browser-to-Node reachability. Include negative fixtures proving UI-to-API, package-to-app and deep-source imports fail.
importPolicy.developmentResolution: Vite source resolution may map only declared public exports. Existing wildcard UI Common source aliases must become explicit public exports for the actually used subpaths; do not carry a wildcard bypass into the combined repository.

artifacts.imageRegistryAndPromotion: Preserve distinct image identities; registry/organization cutover and live deployment references require their separate review. No publication or deployment is authorized by this design.

affectedBuilds.algorithm: Start with changed owning packages and follow declared reverse dependencies. Changes to root workspace/build tooling select every app. Resolve OpenAPI references conservatively across all specs/schemas/shared/fixtures/scripts; OpenAPI changes select all internal generation targets and apps plus the external-consumer handoff.
affectedBuilds.externalConsumers: Notify Graph and Embeddings when their pinned spec closure changes; never silently rebuild them against a floating checkout.

integrationFiles.laterChange: Replace sibling links with current-workspace public exports; preserve live UI Common source resolution, Puck integration and browser singleton peers.
Extract the listed closures, retain browser adapters/public UI exports, replace CLI-only declaration shims with package declarations and explicit browser/Node exports.

Use extracted public packages; remove sibling build paths, link override and dist/types imports. Preserve ESM bundle/runtime externals and verify isolated installation. Rewrite actual import sites mechanically against the recorded public surfaces.
Use combined openapi root and reviewed source identity; preserve generator options, postprocessors, staging/cache and lock semantics.
Pin the same combined spec root in every resolver, relocate headless output with its owner, and preserve postprocessing order.
Generate from the reviewed in-repository spec, retain CLI-specific output, and remove the second OpenAPI checkout from drift CI.
Keep validation and shared builders authoritative. Root orchestration runs the listed consumer recipes rather than substituting OpenAPI's differently configured example clients.
Build from combined root; remove separate UI Common checkout/additional context and use one combined source provenance.
Build API from combined root with its required runtime assets; adapt source-root discovery without weakening per-worktree database isolation.

Generation drift checks match the reviewed source identity without collapsing incompatible targets.
